# Tooltip

Names an icon-only control or clarifies a short label on hover and keyboard focus.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tooltip` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tooltip label={…}>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tooltip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Tooltip" label="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Ink tooltip on hover and keyboard focus, centred over the trigger, Escape to hide.

## Props (TooltipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` | The short text shown. 1 to 4 words; never essential instructions. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactElement` | Exactly one focusable element. Receives aria-describedby. |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | @default "top" |
| `delay` | `number` | Show delay in ms. @default 250 |
| `id` | `string` |  |
